part.text:
Fixed `finalizeHeredoc` to use consistent byte-based string slicing, eliminating the rune/byte index mismatch that caused the out-of-range panic. Also corrected heredoc assembly to preserve intended content without an extra trailing newline.

`go test ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/` and `go vet ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/` pass. Integration tests could not run because unavailable modules require network access.
